- Six "Active Projects"
  - One operational commercial-scale wind project (South Fork Wind Farm)
  - Two projects partially operational during construction (Vineyard Wind 1 and Revolution Wind)
    - Rev Wind came online after the report text was finalized
  - Three projects under construction (Sunrise Wind, Empire Wind 1, Central Virginia Offshore Wind)
- Most wind lease areas that have had construction activities are in the NY Bight and Southern New England
- 32 additional projects have not yet begun construction
- Construction timelines are uncertain
